method: Full pinned German catalog read, blob verification, active-entry parsing and normal/use-fuzzy msgfmt. Initial printed output clipped middle; reread665..805 before credit. Heuristic added-placeholder scan complements semantic read, not exhaustive format analysis.
findings: 264 active entries,212 nonempty,67 fuzzy,145 nonfuzzy nonempty. Normal msgfmt checks exit0 with four placeholder-header warnings; explicit use-fuzzy exits1 with13 fatal errors.

Fuzzy entries include opposite backup/cross-mount wording and file-name wording for layout/dirname/relative path. These are pending translations, excluded normally; no active-policy inversion claimed.

Same extra percent-s replay-node translation as French is fuzzy here and excluded. Heuristic scan of active nonfuzzy messages introducing placeholders into placeholder-free source found no candidates; this narrow scan is not proof of all format correctness.
Active output-writing error incorrectly says cannot open for reading, obscuring actual write failure. Active stamp message repeats finish-time promise already contradicted by INIT source writer.
Fuzzy read errors change long-long counters to int; several parser errors omit arguments. Do not remove fuzzy flags without format and semantic validation.
POT truncated Only first percent key is translated but cannot match full runtime key containing format macro. Successful compilation cannot establish actual lookup coverage.
Most new reflink exit states and GUI settings remain blank/fuzzy. Historical obsolete entries and template-date metadata do not count as verified localization.
